title: Compare landed timing with a filtered moving average

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained test detects the selected strict upper-bound fault.

- **Source and revision.** `SEED-285#compare-landed-timing-with-recent-builds`, `.planning/seeds/SEED-285-landed-ci-timing-history.md#compare-landed-timing-with-recent-builds`, Initial baseline rule and Key example 1; completed plan `.planning/slice-plans/555-compare-landed-timing-with-recent-builds/PLAN.md`. Both were read from detached revision `56e4a58ddcb0deff4bb812ba8b567241dec47e00`.
- **Promise and fixture.** Compute one median and exclude only values strictly greater than 115% of it. The unchanged shared MakeMe fixture supplies prior wall times 100000, 100000, 100000, 100000, 115000 and 116000 ms, with selected 120000 ms. Expected median: 100000 ms; retained sample count: five; average: 103000 ms.
- **Fault.** Changed the unique comparison at `dashboard/src/ciPriorBuildReference.ts:144` from `sample.ms * 100 > medianMs * 115` to `sample.ms * 100 >= medianMs * 115`. No fixture or assertion was edited.
- **Maintained assertion and reach.** `tests/support/ci-prior-build-reference.test.mjs:54`, “one exact upper filter includes 115, excludes 116 and computes 103 with +17 from six prior builds.” The injected run reached line 59, `assert.equal(result.averageMs, 103000)`, and failed with actual `undefined`; the preceding median assertion passed. This is the intended assertion failing on the wrong result, rather than an unrelated failure.
- **Wrong-behavior observation.** Independently evaluated the unchanged maintained fixture through its normal `wallTimeReferenceOf` path while the fault was present. The result retained median 100000 ms but wrongly marked the 115000 ms sample excluded, leaving `sampleCount: 4` and no average. The 116000 ms sample remained excluded and selected measurement remained 120000 ms.
- **Runs.** AC power was verified. Baseline, injected and restored runs used the same focused command: `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH caffeinate -s -i bash scripts/test.sh tests/support/ci-prior-build-reference.test.mjs`. Baseline passed, injected run failed as above, restored run passed. An initial setup attempt lacked `zod`; checkout-owned `npm ci --ignore-scripts --include=dev` repaired the dependency setup before the passing baseline. No unrelated test failure remained.
- **Restoration and isolation.** Pre-probe Git state was clean. An EXIT/signal restoration arrangement protected the temporary edit. Original source bytes were restored and compared; SHA-256 checks verified both production source and maintained test matched pre-probe bytes. Git tracked/index/status checks were clean and the restored focused run passed. Removed only the owned detached scratch checkout. The parent checkout and branch were not edited. The report finisher was retained outside scratch and verified byte-identical to that revision's installed finisher before removal.
- **Test runtime.** 0.6 seconds total (measured): baseline 0.2 s, injected 0.2 s, restored 0.2 s, from the maintained runner's per-job timing files, reported to tenths of a second. The initial missing-dependency attempt has no retained runner timing and is excluded from this total; its setup time is included in invocation-to-report elapsed.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no separate human-effort measurement was supplied or recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable: no separate token, compute-time or monetary accounting was exposed for this invocation; wall-clock elapsed is not substituted for agent effort.

Invocation start was captured from the host clock before source lookup: `2026-11-10T07:36:48Z` (one-second clock-reading resolution), converted to `1794296208000` Unix epoch ms. The finisher's cutoff is report production before subsequent delivery.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 216467 ms (measured), from 1794296208000 to 1794296424467 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
